_doc: Rare kin mutations (shimmer stays the shiny). rarity: 1 in N for a wild or newly hatched kin at base odds. group: at most one per group. visual: scale (body size), palette (per material slot: mix/amt, darken, lighten, desat, set; swap trades body and belly), rim (rim light strength), part (an extra part drawn by Mutations.dress), tint. perk: multipliers on the kin's own stats (hp, dmg, speed, cd; kept within 0.85..1.15), owner: flat bonuses for the hunter carrying it (armor up to 10, sight up to 0.15). badge: the shape drawn on its badge.

mutations.name: Giant
mutations.desc: Half again as big as it should be.

mutations.name: Piebald
mutations.desc: A pale coat splashed with patches of its true colour.

mutations.name: Melanistic
mutations.desc: Coal-dark all over, with gold eyes.

mutations.name: Glowing
mutations.desc: Its markings shine in the dark. Its hunter sees a little further.

mutations.name: Twin-tail
mutations.desc: Born with two tails, and doubly restless.

mutations.name: Crystal
mutations.desc: Gem spikes grow along its back. Riding with you, they harden your armor.

mutations.name: Starmarked
mutations.desc: Speckled with tiny stars. A lucky kin: a little better at everything.
